verdict.rationale: The only hours in the evidence are Live Support hours (8:30am–4:00pm weekdays). Those cover human support, not an operating window, per-day limit, or session timeout for the online filing flow, so they are an adjacent control that earns no credit. The probe shows the Taxpayer Portal sits behind an authenticated session, but no published availability window or timeout policy appears anywhere.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
